name: S-Pipe Flashing PVC
paste:
S-PIPE FLASHING PVC: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: S-Pipe Flashing PVC, April 2023, Version 01.02 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/j/s-pipe_flashing_pvc.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide S-Pipe Flashing PVC where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02).
1.2 Product description. S-Pipe Flashing PVC is a prefabricated pipe/vent flashing, based on a polyvinyl chloride (PVC) multi-layer, roof waterproofing membrane containing ultraviolet light stabilisers and flame retarders.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer.
    - Pipe/vent flashing on Sarnafil® G/S and Sikaplan® PVC flat roof systems.
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.3.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. S-Pipe Flashing PVC
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Prefabricated PVC pipe/vent flashing
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.02) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Resistant to UV exposure
    - Easy and safe application
    - Heat weldable
2.4 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: Polyvinyl chloride (PVC)
2.5 Appearance and colour.
    | Surface: | smooth |
    | Colour: | light grey (nearest RAL 7047) |
    | window grey (nearest RAL 7040) lead grey (Sika colour no. 9500) copper patina (Sika colour no. 6525) copper brown (nearest RAL 8004) traffic white (nearest RAL 9016) other colours on request |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)

2.7 System structure. The following products must be considered for use depending on roof design:
    - Cap for vent pipe in various sizes
    - Sarnafil® G 410-types
    - Sarnafil® G 411-types
    - Sarnafil® S 327-types
    - Sikaplan® G / VG / VGWT / S / SG / SGmA / SGK
2.8 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: Depending on the order quantity and product size, the products are packaged on pallets or in cartons.
    - Shelf life: 5 years from date of production
2.9 Storage conditions. The product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged packaging in dry conditions between +5 °C and +30 °C. Do not stack pallets of rolls or any other material on top during transport or storage.Always refer to packaging.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.02) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application.
    - Installation procedure
    - Reference must be made to further documentation where applicable, such as relevant method statement, application manual and installation or working instructions.
4.3 Limitations and important considerations. Installation work must only be carried out by Sika® trained and approved contractors, experienced in this type of application.
    - The use of S-Pipe Flashing PVC is limited to geographical locations with average monthly minimum temperatures of -50 °C. Permanent ambient temperature during use is limited to +50 °C.
    - Installation of some ancillary products, e.g. contact adhesives / cleaners is limited to temperatures above +5 °C. Refer to information given by Product Data Sheets.
    - Special measures may be compulsory for installation below +5 °C ambient temperature due to safety requirements in accordance with national regulations.
4.4 Further information.
    - Installation instructions for Sarnafil®- and Sikaplan® flat roof waterproofing membranes.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Ambient air temperature. -20 °C min. / +60 °C max.
5.3 Substrate temperature. -30 °C min. / +60 °C max.
5.4 Conditions stated in the limitations. Also stated in the data sheet limitations (clause 4.3):
    - The use of S-Pipe Flashing PVC is limited to geographical locations with average monthly minimum temperatures of -50 °C. Permanent ambient temperature during use is limited to +50 °C.
    - Installation of some ancillary products, e.g. contact adhesives / cleaners is limited to temperatures above +5 °C. Refer to information given by Product Data Sheets.
    - Special measures may be compulsory for installation below +5 °C ambient temperature due to safety requirements in accordance with national regulations.
5.5 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.6 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: S-Pipe Flashing PVC, April 2023, Version 01.02, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/j/s-pipe_flashing_pvc.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety - Regulation (ec) no 1907/2006 - reach. This product is an article as defined in article 3 of regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 (REACH). It contains no substances which are intended to be released from the article under normal or reasonably foreseeable conditions of use. A safety data sheet following article 31 of the same regulation is not needed to bring the product to the market, to transport or to use it. For safe use follow the instructions given in the product data sheet. Based on our current knowledge, this product does not contain SVHC (substances of very high concern) as listed in Annex XIV of the REACH regulation or on the candidate list published by the European Chemicals Agency in concentrations above 0,1 % (w/w).
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
